notes.title: We’re in Steam Next Fest (Oct 13 - 20): Chapter 1 demo incoming!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! I’m thrilled to confirm [b]The Infernalist[/b] will be part of [b]Steam Next Fest (Oct 13 - 20, 2025)[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]During the event there'll be a [b]free playable demo of Chapter 1[/b]: A taste of Lyra Quasar’s mysterious journey through a world where ancient myths and advanced tech collide. The demo’s focused on the early puzzles, exploration, and the story thread that sets up the full chapter.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Full Chapter 1[/b] will be part of the [b]Early Access launch planned for Q1 2026[/b], so think of this as a sneak peek that lets you experience the beginning and share your feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]How you can help:[/p][list][*][p][b]Wishlist[/b] and [b]Follow[/b] the game on Steam. This directly boosts visibility.[/p][/*][*][p]Try the demo during Next Fest. It will be available from the start of the festival.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Share feedback[/b] here or on X/Discord. It’s hugely valuable for polishing the Early Access release.[/p][/*][/list][p]I’m a solo dev, but I’ll be watching for feedback and will patch anything urgent during the week.[/p][p][/p][p]Big thanks for your support, and I can’t wait for you to try this upcoming [b]demo of Chapter 1[/b]! 🔥[/p]

notes.title: The Infernalist - Reveal Trailer is Here!
notes.notes: [quote][p]So it begins.[/p][p]I'm excited to unveil the [b]official reveal trailer[/b] for [i]The Infernalist[/i], a [b]point-and-click[/b] adventure where you dive into a rich narrative filled with exploration, puzzles, and turn-based combat.[/p][p]This first look teases the visuals, music, gameplay, and turn-based combat system.[/p][/quote][p][/p][previewyoutube="Ul_5iQYoERo;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][quote][p]🔥 [b]Watch the YouTube[/b] [b]trailer above [/b][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3824970"]or directly on the Steam store page[/url][/p][p]❤️ [b]Wishlist the game[/b] to follow development[/p][p]🧪 [b]Chapter 1 (Early Access)[/b] is coming soon, and a playable demo is just around the corner[/p][/quote]
